scripts.build: bunx tarve build src/youtube-music.tsx --runtime txiki --packs --key youtube-music-update.key --outfile dist/YouTubeMusic.exe
scripts.build:bun: bunx tarve build src/youtube-music.tsx --runtime bun --packs --key youtube-music-update.key --outfile dist/bun/YouTubeMusic.exe
scripts.package: bun run build && bunx tarve package dist/YouTubeMusic.exe --format setup,zip --out dist/release

tarve.name: YouTube Music
tarve.description: Cliente do YouTube Music feito com Tarve
